en: A black‑and‑white image showing the ruins of a tall, steep‑roofed stone building with narrow arched windows, likely part of a medieval church or monastery. The gabled stone walls are partially collapsed and surrounded by an orchard or garden with several fruit trees and grass in the foreground. Dense trees and bushes grow around and behind the ruined structure. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image itself.
